newsitem.title: GREECE: DASSAULT BUYS 34PCT STAKE IN NIREUS FISHERY.
newsitem.headline: DASSAULT BUYS 34PCT STAKE IN NIREUS FISHERY.

text.p: Dassault Investissements Ltd, a subsidiary of France's Dassault Industries, is acquiring a 34 percent stake in Nireus Aquaculture subsidiary Oinousses Aquaculture for 200 million drachmas, Nireus said on Tuesday.
"...It is the first step towards a collaboration between the two groups in fish farming activities in Greece and abroad," Nireus said in a statement.
Laurent Dassault and Gerard Limat will join the company's board of directors.
Oinousses Aquaculture SA is implementing a 400 million drachma investment at the island of Chios aimed at the production of new fish products, Nireus said.
The investment has obtained national economy ministry approval under the framework of offseting investments by French companies related to the TALOS-Mirage 2000 aircraft programme.
"Both companies will explore the possibility for joint investments in fish farming and processing, building on Nireus knowhow," it said. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
